summary.text: Jennifer McPherson is the Republican candidate for the Minnesota House of Representatives, District 67A, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a community activist and listed school choice and lower taxes among her campaign messages.

paragraphs.text: Jennifer McPherson was born in St. Paul, Minnesota, and graduated from Harding High School.
Ballotpedia lists her career experience as including member services work for Twin Cities PBS and work at Wendy's.
McPherson ran for the Saint Paul Board of Education at-large seats as a nonpartisan candidate in 2019 and 2021; she was not among the candidates elected in 2021.

In the 2026 survey, she said she helps parents navigate the school system and IEP meetings, and her key messages included school choice, bussing for all schools from pre-K through 12th grade, and lower taxes and cost of living.
